limits.title: Known limits
items: Policy is local: unknown commands are rejected, but broad permissions depend on what you configure.
Composed commands with ;, &&, pipes or $(...) are rejected — structural, not semantic analysis.
The gateway judges intent; it does not execute commands or verify side effects.
No built-in authentication; run on a controlled network.
Local SQLite audit, no cryptographic signature. Not a legal guarantee.

research.title: Research
research.question: Can we generate policy patches that increase resistance to attacks without dropping utility on real tasks below an acceptable limit, while keeping human approval by default?
milestones: Utility baseline and patch-depth lock published with tests
Generated policy validated against SAFE-AI in CI
First resistance measurement with a reproducible adversarial suite
research.note: No benchmark result has been measured yet.
